jemcompat.drill.replace_hint: Service allowance exhausted: stop and replace the drill.
jemcompat.drill.stop_hint: Stop rotation, then use iron ingots to service it.
jemcompat.drill.service_hint: Use iron ingots on the stopped drill to service it.
jemcompat.patchouli.name: JEM Engineering Notes
jemcompat.patchouli.landing_text: A short field guide to the mechanical drill lifecycle.
jemcompat.patchouli.engineering.name: Technologia!
jemcompat.patchouli.engineering.descript: Build, service, and replace mechanical drills.
jemcompat.patchouli.drill_work.name: Put It to Work
jemcompat.patchouli.drill_work.text: Moving and stationary drills both wear while breaking blocks. Jade shows the stationary drill's condition. A worn drill slows down, then breaks at maximum wear; bedrock destroys it immediately.
jemcompat.patchouli.drill_service.name: Service Interval
jemcompat.patchouli.drill_service.text: Stop the contraption or stationary drill's rotation, then use iron ingots on a worn drill. One ingot is consumed per repaired drill. One interaction can service several eligible drills on that contraption or kinetic network.
jemcompat.patchouli.drill_replaced.name: New Drill, Same Job
jemcompat.patchouli.drill_replaced.text: A drill that has used its repair allowance can still finish its work, but it cannot be repaired again. Replace the worn-out drill in the stopped contraption and get the machine moving again.
